description: Method-comparison significance-figure config for analysis/method_significance. Declares which method pairs get a significance bracket ('pairs_mode') and the p-value -> star-symbol cutoffs ('star_thresholds'), in the standard GraphPad/Prism convention. Consumed by method_significance/builder.py::load_comparison_config (fail-fast) and the comparison-figure renderer; it knows nothing about models, countries, or matplotlib. 'pairs_mode' must be one of 'allowed_pairs_modes'; an unknown mode fails loudly. 'star_thresholds' are matched smallest-'max_p'-first (first match wins); a p above every threshold maps to 'ns_symbol'. Pairwise p-values are paired t-tests on the TV values, Holm-corrected across ALL pairs regardless of which subset is drawn, so a reported p never depends on a rendering choice. 'vs-most-complex' draws the reference-vs-rest family: the most complex method against each simpler one.
